_comment: Weapon-usage tracking gun-ID registry (docs/41). APPEND-ONLY. Maps a canonical base weapon name (what acc_weapon_variants::true_base(w).name returns) to a PERMANENT positive integer id. id 0 is reserved = 'other'/unknown catch-all (never listed here). RULES: (1) ids are assigned in registration order and NEVER renumbered; (2) a NEW live box gun appends at max+1 (tools/gen_gun_ids.js auto-appends + warns); (3) a RETIRED gun KEEPS its id here as a tombstone (do NOT delete the line and do NOT reuse the id) so a future restore can't collide and old D1 rows stay meaningful; (4) NEVER derive ids from box order or box_weight rank - both reshuffle on every rebalance. The generator validates this against _acc_map_randomizer.gsc box_weapons[] and regenerates the GSC acc_gun_id() switch + backend/leaderboard/gun_ids.json.
_comment_starting: Guns that are ALSO a free/starting weapon (not acquired FROM the box). Their held-time is inflated by the free grant, so /stats/guns flags is_starting=true and a reader should discount their pref_index. t6_fiveseven is the start pistol (see _acc_map_randomizer.gsc box_weapons comment).
